topics.titleTr: Yapay Zekanın Enerji Faturası: Veri Merkezleri
topics.titleEn: AI's Energy Bill: Data Centers Explained
topics.keywordTr: yapay zeka enerji tüketimi veri merkezi
topics.angle: deep-dive: why AI is straining the grid and what it means for you
topics.brief: Outline: why training and inference are power-hungry; the data-center build-out and its effect on electricity demand, prices, and water use; efficiency levers (better chips, smaller models, scheduling, cooling); what the big labs are doing; what it means for consumers (bills, siting fights) and for builders (cost per token, greener choices). Verify: 2026 data-center energy projections; efficiency trends. Sources: IEA electricity reports; provider sustainability disclosures.

topics.titleTr: Yerel Yapay Zeka İçin Laptop Alma Rehberi
topics.titleEn: Buying a Laptop for Local AI in 2026
topics.keywordTr: yerel yapay zeka laptop alma rehberi
topics.keywordEn: laptop for local ai buying guide
topics.angle: checklist: the specs that matter on-device (and who should skip it)
topics.brief: Outline: what 'local AI' actually needs — unified memory/VRAM first, then NPU TOPS, CPU, and SSD; why RAM size caps which models you can run; Apple Silicon vs Windows Copilot+/NPU vs discrete-GPU laptops; realistic performance for 7B-30B models; a buying checklist by budget; contrarian note — most people are better off with cloud APIs. Verify: NPU TOPS relevance; memory requirements per model size. Sources: vendor specs; local-LLM community benchmarks.

topics.titleTr: Yapay Zeka Ses Klonu Dolandırıcılığından Korunma
topics.titleEn: Protect Your Family from AI Voice-Clone Scams
topics.angle: checklist: spot and stop voice-cloning phone and video scams
topics.brief: Outline: how cheap voice/video cloning now enables 'family emergency' and CEO-fraud calls; red flags (urgency, secrecy, unusual payment); defenses — a family safe word, call-back verification, locking down voice samples, bank verification steps; what to do if targeted (report, freeze, preserve evidence); teaching elderly relatives. Verify: 2026 scam trends and reporting channels. Sources: FTC/consumer-protection guidance; bank fraud resources.

topics.titleTr: Kanıta Dayalı Yatırım: Slaytların Sonu mu?
topics.titleEn: Proof-Based Fundraising: The Pitch Deck's End?
topics.angle: deep-dive: why traction beats slides for raising in 2026
topics.brief: Outline: the shift from deck-only pitches to proof — live product, usage, revenue, retention; what investors now ask for at each stage and typical 2026 AI round sizes; building a data room and metrics narrative; how AI lets tiny teams show traction fast; when a deck still matters; the risk of vanity metrics. Contrarian: spend less time on the deck, more on evidence. Verify: 2026 round-size and AI-capital figures. Sources: Carta/PitchBook data; investor essays.

topics.titleTr: ChatGPT ile SaaS Finansal Modeli Kurmak
topics.titleEn: Build a SaaS Financial Model with ChatGPT
topics.angle: how-to: build a founder-grade forecast and runway model in a spreadsheet
topics.brief: Outline: what a lightweight model needs — revenue (new/expansion/churn), COGS incl. AI/token costs, headcount, burn, runway; use ChatGPT to scaffold spreadsheet formulas, an assumptions tab, and scenarios; sanity-check outputs and avoid hallucinated formulas; sensitivity analysis (CAC, churn, price); turning it into an investor-ready one-pager. Verify: ChatGPT spreadsheet/analysis accuracy; SaaS metric definitions. Sources: SaaS metrics references; OpenAI help.
